spec: ECO Requirement 2 (Invalid-Cycle Output Quiescent): Without changing valid_out timing/latency or any interfaces, when valid_out==0 the data_out behavior shall be made deterministic: either (A) force data_out to 16'sd0, or (B) hold the last value produced when valid_out==1. When valid_out==1, data_out must match the current signoff implementation bit-for-bit (except where clamped by an approved saturation feature). Do not add new top-level ports; implement only as a final-stage mux/enable change near data_out.
